title: Security Forces Arrest Eight Terror Associates in Coordinated Kulgam, Shopian Operations
detail: Security forces conducted two separate counter-terror operations in south Kashmir on August 26, 2026. In Kulgam's Bugam orchard area, a joint team of Kulgam Police, the Army's 9 Rashtriya Rifles and 18 Battalion CRPF carried out a cordon-and-search operation based on specific intelligence and arrested five overground workers (OGWs) of terrorist outfits, recovering four 9mm pistols, four magazines, 22 rounds of ammunition and two hand grenades. Separately, police in South Kashmir's Shopian district apprehended three men — identified as Junaid Ahmad Dar, Amir Yousif and Junaid Muzaffer, all residents of Kulgam district — along with a motorcycle during a naka (checkpoint) checking operation, recovering two hand grenades and five posters bearing Hizbul Mujahideen (HM) markings. No casualties were reported in either operation; investigations into both are underway.

media.caption: Security forces detail the Kulgam arms-cache recovery and arrests, August 26, 2026

confidenceReason: Based on police/security-source reporting via multiple Kashmir-based Tier-2 outlets; no named on-record Army/CRPF spokesperson statement cited for either operation.
